content: Suwedlahn mehn Sodom kan
Ni tohnleng riemeno ara lel Sodom nin soutikpene, Lohd wie mwomwohd ni ewen kelen kahnimwo, wasa aramas akan kin pokonpene ie. Eri, ni Lohd eh kilangirahda, e ahpw uhda oh rahnmwahwih ira

oh patohwan, “Maing ko, iet ngehi, I patopato wasaht pwe I en papah kumwa. Kumwa ketido ni imweiet. Kumwa pahn widen aluweluwamwa kan oh pweiekidi rehi. Nimenseng kumwa ahpw pahn usehla sapwellimamwa seiloak.” Ira ahpw sapeng Lohd, mahsanih, “Soh! Se pahn kommoaldi wasaht nan wasahn tuhpene en kahnimwet.”

Ahpw Lohd ngidingidkihong ira en iangada, ketilahng ni imweo. Re ahpw ketiketla. Lohd eri ndaiong nah sounpapah ko re en umwun pilawa oh kaunopada kisin sak mwahu ong aramas en keiru ko. Ni soahng koaros eh nekier, re ahpw sak.
Mwohn mehn keiru ko ara pahn kolahng meirla, ohlen Sodom kan ahpw kapilpene ihmwo. Ohl koaros en kahnimwo, me pwulopwul oh me mah kan, iang mi wasao.
Re ahpw likwerih Lohd oh idek reh, “Ia ohl ako me kodohng pweidi rehmw nipwonget? Waieirahdo mahs pwe se en kak kapwaiada rehra ineng suwed en paliwarat akan, pwe se en pein kalel mahs nanpwungat.”
Lohd ahpw pwerieila rehrail, oh ritingedi wenihmwo,
e ahpw ndalahng irail, “Maing ko, menlau kumwail dehr wia soangen tiahk suweden!

Iet, mie nei serepein riemen me meipwon. I pahn kihong kumwail pwe kumwail en wiahiong ira nsenamwail. Ahpw I peki rehmwail, kumwail dehr wiahiong mehkot ohl pwukat, pwe ira mehn keiru kei ni imweiet, oh I uhdahn pahn apwalih ira.”

A irail sapeng, ndalahng, “Pwulahkasang men; kowe mehn liki men! Ihs kowe pwe ke en ndahng kiht dahme se en wia? Keisang men, pwe se de pil wiahiong uhk me pahn suwed sang me se pahn wiahiong ira.” Re ahpw sikenla Lohd oh doudahla pwe re en kauwehla wenihmwo.
A iet ohl riemen me mihmi loaleo sewesehda Lohd, sikenlong ong loale; ira ahpw ritingedi wenihmwo.
Ira ahpw karotongehla mesen me mihmi liki ko koaros, irail eri sohla kak diar wenihmwo.
Lohd Mweselsang Sodom
Ohlen keiru riemeno eri idek rehn Lohd, “Mie kisehmw wasaht—noumw pwutak kan, serepein kan, oh en noumw kan ar pwoud kan, de kisehmw me iang koukousoan nan kahnimwet—wairailsang wasaht,
pwe se pahn kamwomwala wasaht. KAUN-O ketin karongeier kedip suwed koaros ong tohn kahnimw wet, oh e ketin poaroneikitodo pwe se en kamwomwala Sodom.”

Lohd eri kohla rehn ohl ako me pahn pwoudiki nah serepein ko, oh ndaiong ira, “Kumwa mwadang iang kohkohla sang wasaht; pwe KAUN-O pahn ketin kamwomwala wasaht.” Ira ahpw kihkihong me e wie kamwakamwanohng ira.

Nin sohrahno tohnleng ko ahpw keruwahda Lohd, mahsanihong, “Mwadang! Ale omw pwouden oh noumw serepein riemen en, oh mwadangehisang met, pwe kumwail dehr pil iang ohla ni kamwomwmwomwlahn kahnimw wet.”
Lohd ahpw peikasalda; a KAUN-O ketin kupwurehla. Ihme tohnleng ko alehte pehn Lohd, pehn eh pwoudo, oh pehn nah serepein ko, oh kahreirailieisang nan kahnimwo.
Ni ar miher likin kahnimwo, emen tohnleng ko mahsanihong Lohd, “Tang, pwe ke en mourla! Ke dehpa sohpeila pohn souwomwen, oh dehpa uhdi nan wahu. Tenge nahna kan, pwe ke de pil iang kamakamala.”
Lohd ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Soh, maing! Kaidehkin men me pahn wiawi.
Maing, komw ketin kupwureielahr mehlel; sapwellimomwi kalahngan me doareielahr. Nahna kan me nohn doh; mwohn ei pahn lel mwo kalokolok wet pahn koanoaiehdi oh I pahn mehla.
Komw mahsanih kisin kahnimwen? I kak lellahng mwo pwe me keren. Komw mweidohng ie I en patolahng mwo—wasa tikitik kis—oh ih wasa I kak pitla ie.
Tohnlengo eri sapeng, “Eri, me mwahu! I sohte pahn kamwomwala kisin kahnimwen.
Nna, mwadang tenge wasao! I sohte kak wia mehkot ke lao lel mwo.” Pwehki Lohd e kahdaneki kahnimwo kisin kahnimw tikitik, ihme kahnimwo adanekihki Soar.
Kamwomwmwomwlahn Sodom oh Komora
Lohd ahpw lel Soar ni ahnsou me ketipino ahpwtehn dakada.
KAUN-O eri ketin kamwerehdi suwepel okohk,
pohn Sodom oh Komora.
E ahpw ketin kamwomwala kahnimw ko oh nan wahuo pwon, iangahki tohn kahnimw ko koaros oh mehkoaros me audepen sahpwo.
Ahpw en Lohd eh pwoud, me kilengla mwuri, e ahpw pikla wiahla uhr soahl.
Mandahn rahno, nimensehngie, Eipraam ahpw sangkalahng wasa e patohwan tuhwong KAUN-O ie.
E ahpw kilengdilahng Sodom oh Komora oh nan wahuo pwon, e ahpw kilangada duwen ediniei eh ediedida sang nan sahpwo, rasehng edin uhmw kalaimwun ehu.
Ahpw ni ahnsou me Koht ketin kamwomwala kahnimw ko nan wahuo, e ketin kupwukupwurehte Eipraam oh ketin mweidohng Lohd en pitla.
Tepin mehn Mohap oh mehn Ammon
Pwehki Lohd eh masak mihmihte Soar, ih oh nah serepein riemeno ahpw douluhllahng nin nahna kan; irail eri kin koukousoan nan pwoar ehu.
Nah serepein laudo eri ndaiong me tikitiko, “Kilang, ata pahpao likeilapalahr, oh sohte ohl emen nin sampah pwon luhwehdi me kak pwoudikinkitahda pwe kita en neitik seri duwen me kin wiawi.
Nna, kita kasakawihkihla wain e lao sakaula douluhl; kita ahpw wendi reh tuhkihong paliwarata pwe kita en neitikihong ata pahpa.”
Eri, nipwongo ira ahpw kasakawihkihla wain e lao sakaula douluhl. Serepein laudo eri wendi rehn eh pahpao oh tuhkihong paliwereo. Eh pahpao ahpw sohte kehnda mehkot nan eh sakaula douluhl.

Mandahn rahno serepein laudo ahpw ndaiong me tikitiko, “Pwohng I wendi rehn pahpa oh tuhkihong paliwereiet. Kita pil kasakawihkihla wain pwonget, kowe eri pahn uhd wia duwen me I wiadahr. Kita koaros eri pahn neitikiong at pahpao.”
Eri, nipwongo ira ahpw pil kasakawihkihla wain e lao sakaula; oh serepein tikitiko ahpw uhd wendi rehn eh pahpao, oh tuhkihong paliwereo. Nan eh sakaula douluhl e ahpw sohte mwahn pil kehnda wasa.
Iei duwen met nein Lohd serepein riemeno ara liseianohng ara pahpao.
Serepein laudo eri naitikihada pwutak emen me e kihong ede Mohap.
Ih me wia semen mehn Mohap en ahnsou wet kan.
Me tikitiko pil naitikihada nah pwutak emen, me e kihong ede Penami.
Ih me wia semen mehn Ammon en ahnsouwet kan.

19.24 SUWEPEL: Tehk nan kawehwehpen lepin mahsen kan.
19.37 MOHAP: Sisen ahd wet ekis duwehte lepin mahsen en Ipru me wehwehki “sang rehn semei.”
19.38 PENAMI: Ahd wet ni mahsen en Ipru wehwehki “nein kisehi” oh sisen ahd wet ekis duwehte sisen lepin mahsen me wehwehki “mehn Ammon.” Ih me wia semen mehn Ammon en ahnsou wet kan.
